description: This Java source file defines the class DialogHelperImpl, which implements the DialogHelper interface. It provides an implementation for displaying dialogs in an Android activity, specifically handling exception error dialogs using AlertDialog. The class manages dialog creation and display, including passing exception details to the dialog for user display.

classes.name: DialogHelperImpl
classes.description: Implements dialog handling logic within an Android activity context, allowing for the display of exception messages in a dialog.

methods.name: DialogHelperImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with an Activity context.

methods.name: showErrorMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays an error message dialog with a string title and an exception.

methods.description: Creates dialogs based on the dialog ID and provided Bundle, specifically handling exception dialogs.

methods.name: convertExceptionToErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an Exception object into a user-friendly error message string.
